This $9 Pokémon card sells for ??? in a PSA 10 👀 Guess before you swipe

Guess the PSA 10 price of all 4 cheap Pokémon cards, then swipe for the answers. How close were you? 👇

Answers (no peeking 🙈):
#1 Kingdra TG03/TG30 (Astral Radiance Trainer Gallery): $9.37 raw → $339 PSA 10 (36×)
#2 Keldeo GG07/GG70 (Crown Zenith: Galarian Gallery): $14.78 raw → $330 PSA 10 (22×)
#3 Lampent 102/086 (White Flare): $12.55 raw → $270 PSA 10 (22×)
#4 Quaxly 206/193 (Paldea Evolved): $14.41 raw → $223 PSA 10 (15×)

PSA 10 = median eBay sold price over the last 60 days. Raw = TCGplayer market price. Not every card grades a 10, so check centering first (free centering tool at market.driveyourstyle.net).
